what.value_plain: Cowen bull market support band: bounce, band lost, 50-day fake-out, others-at-the-band catch-down, BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT: BTC / USDT, band = 20-week SMA and 21-week EMA of completed weeks: when ETH trades at its own band and BTC / USDT closes 8 % above its band, go short; market entry at the next day's open, stop 2 x ATR14 (daily) from the signal close, exit at the top of the band; the idea is dropped after 2 daily closes above the signal close, or after 30 days; fees 0.02 % limit / 0.05 % market, plus 0.02 % slippage on market and stop fills; 2022-04-01 to 2024-06-30, development window only. The band needs 21 completed weeks, so the first signals come in June 2022.
